premise: In this original retelling, the Thread of Truth has vanished from the Moirai. Thalia, Asteria and Dorian follow its fragments from Delphi to Crete and the Aegean, restoring the memories that hold their cities together.

heroes.description: Thalia studies the signs of Athena. Her lamp and patient questions uncover hidden paths. Recognize her ivory robes, teal mantle and owl clasp.
Asteria navigates by the stars and honors Artemis. She scouts dangerous crossings with a bow at her side. Recognize her indigo tunic and silver crescent.
Dorian is a citizen sworn to protect his companions. He carries a bronze shield and follows the ideal of a just polis. Recognize his terracotta cloak and bronze armor.

scenarios.title: The Silent Oracle
scenarios.objective: Follow Apollo’s fallen light through Delphi. Read three shadow inscriptions with the lamp, align the sun mirrors, and reopen the oracle’s spring.
scenarios.philosophical_question: Is knowledge received, or earned by asking better questions?
steps: Align the mirrors and recover the first thread.
scenarios.myth: Apollo and the oracle at Delphi
scenarios.status: Scenario brief — not yet a playable map

scenarios.title: The Thread Beneath Knossos
scenarios.objective: Carry Ariadne’s thread into the labyrinth. Mark the return route, open the floodgates together, and lead the Minotaur away from the sealed chamber.
scenarios.philosophical_question: What makes a person the same self after every turning?
steps: Anchor the thread at the entrance.
Pass the guardian and recover the second thread.
scenarios.status: Scenario brief — not yet a playable map

scenarios.title: The Unbound Winds
scenarios.objective: Recover the wind vessels scattered across the islands of Aeolus. Cross the sea caves, evade harpies and return the winds to the keeper.
steps: Seal the storm and restore the sea route.
scenarios.status: Scenario brief — not yet a playable map

scenarios.title: The Trial in the Agora
scenarios.setting: A moonlit agora haunted by false testimony
scenarios.objective: Restore the names erased from the agora. Compare three witnesses, find the broken oath tablet, and release the warriors bound to a false accusation.
scenarios.philosophical_question: Is justice merely agreement, or does it ask more of us?
steps: Present the evidence and free the guardians.
scenarios.myth: Greek civic life and the restless dead
scenarios.status: Scenario brief — not yet a playable map

enemies.name: Spartoi — the oathless warriors
enemies.origin: Inspired by the warriors born from dragon teeth. This game reimagines them as restless guardians.
enemies.description: A bronze helmet rises from a heap of bones. The warrior wakes when approached and throws bones from a distance.
enemies.tactic: Let it rise, step out of the projectile line, then close the distance.
enemies.status: Playable skeleton enemy — original pixel sprite

enemies.name: Harpy — raider of the winds
enemies.origin: Inspired by the winged harpies of Greek myth.
enemies.description: Dark wings and hooked talons mark this hunter above the sea cliffs.
enemies.tactic: Planned encounter: watch for a dive, dodge sideways, then strike while it lands.

enemies.name: Talos — the bronze sentinel
enemies.origin: Inspired by the bronze guardian of Crete.
enemies.description: A towering automaton guards the island gates; amber seams reveal its inner fire.
enemies.tactic: Planned encounter: avoid the heavy stomp and expose the seal at its ankle.

enemies.name: Minotaur — keeper of the labyrinth
enemies.origin: Inspired by the bull-headed creature of the Cretan labyrinth.
enemies.description: Broad horns and a heavy silhouette announce the guardian beyond the maze.
enemies.tactic: Planned encounter: guide its charge into a pillar, then follow Ariadne’s thread to safety.
